name: Alert / Banner
summary: Inline visible feedback with four semantic variants, explicit dynamic announcement priority, resilient text, and optional canonical Close Button dismissal.

anatomy.name: dismiss
anatomy.description: Optional dismiss control, usually Close Button.

states.name: default
states.description: Visible alert; semantic severity is selected through its variant.

behavior.name: announcement
behavior.description: Static content uses no live-region semantics. Targets choose polite status or assertive alert only when dynamically inserted timing and urgency require it; the visual Banner name never maps to the ARIA banner landmark.

behavior.name: dismiss
behavior.description: Dismissible alerts compose a named canonical Close Button. When dismissAction is present, dismissLabel is conditionally required; the consumer owns removal, persistence, motion, focus, and follow-up announcements.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: Localized and indivisible title/message content wraps rather than creating page-level horizontal overflow.

behavior.name: semanticAccent
behavior.description: Background tints use the semantic feedback token directly; border and decorative icon derive a stronger private theme-aware accent from that family and primary text without creating a new public token.

properties.name: message
properties.description: Visible feedback message that communicates meaning without color or icon alone.

properties.name: dismissAction
properties.description: Optional Close Button that requests removal of the alert.

properties.name: dismissLabel
properties.description: Accessible name for the optional dismiss action.

properties.name: announcement
properties.description: Live-region priority used only when feedback is inserted dynamically.

accessibility: Use live-region semantics only for alerts inserted dynamically.
Provide visible text for the message; do not rely on icon or color alone.
Do not map the visual Banner name to the ARIA banner landmark role.
Name dismiss controls clearly whenever the optional Close Button is present.
Choose assertive announcements only for urgent failures.
Do not move focus merely because an alert is announced.
Allow long localized or unbroken title/message content to wrap without clipping or page overflow.

web.notes: Implemented by semantic variant classes, resilient typography, optional live-region attributes, and canonical Close Button composition in components/css/primitives.css.
